V01.title: Enterprise Account Executive
screening_questions: Walk me through an enterprise deal you personally closed: who controlled budget, which decision criteria mattered and what almost stopped the deal?
How would you qualify an AI use case before involving technical colleagues, and when would you advise a customer not to proceed?
Describe a procurement or commercial negotiation where you protected value while giving the customer a credible route to agreement.

V02.title: Business Development Representative
screening_questions: Choose a fictional target account: which buying signals and business problem would justify your outreach?
How would you distinguish curiosity about AI from a qualified opportunity worth an account executive’s time?
Tell me how you changed an outreach sequence after low response rates, and which measures showed the change helped.

V03.title: Sales Engineer
screening_questions: A customer wants to connect an LLM to internal knowledge: what would you clarify about data access, evaluation and failure modes before proposing a design?
Describe a proof of concept you supported: what success criteria did you agree, and how did you handle results that missed them?
Explain an API integration trade-off to a commercial sponsor without overstating reliability or promising capabilities you have not tested.

V04.title: Account Manager
screening_questions: Describe an account where usage was healthy but business value was unclear: how did you uncover the gap?
How would you build an adoption plan across an executive sponsor, IT stakeholders and end users with competing priorities?
Tell me about a renewal or expansion at risk: what evidence changed your plan and what did you personally do?

V05.title: Sales Leadership
screening_questions: Walk me through a forecast you challenged: what deal evidence changed your view and how did you communicate the risk?
Describe how you coached a strong seller whose discovery or qualification was weak; what changed in their behaviour?
With limited hiring capacity, how would you choose between adding prospecting, account executive and technical pre-sales capacity?
